_comments: API SCOPES FOR THE SALES REMOTE OPERATIONS (#186). Sales.CloseDeal and Sales.ReopenDeal declare RequiredScope
sales:write (metadata/remote-operations). Without these rows MJAPI refuses every API-key call to either
operation on a host that installs Sales.
A parent `sales` with a write child, matching how MJ lays out its own scopes. The application ceiling that
allows it on MJAPI is in metadata/api-application-scopes. A host then only issues API keys.

fields.Name: sales
fields.Description: Parent scope for Sales remote operations

fields.Name: write
fields.Description: Sales operations that change data: close and reopen a deal
